map.单循环进尺 = 炮孔深度 × 炮孔利用率（η 通常 0.85~0.95）: Advance per cycle = blast-hole depth × utilization (η usually 0.85–0.95)

map.📚 深度解析：隧道掘进速度估算: 📚 Deep Dive: Tunnel Advance Rate Estimate
map.单循环进尺：循环进尺=炮孔深度×炮孔利用率 η（一般 0.85~0.95，由岩性: Per-cycle advance: cycle advance = blast hole depth × hole utilisation η (generally 0.85~0.95, determined by rock quality and drilling accuracy); increasing the hole depth raises the advance, but η usually falls accordingly.
map.循环时间与循环数：单循环时间=钻孔+爆破+通风+出渣+支护各工序耗时之和；时间允: Cycle time and cycle count: cycle time is the sum of drilling, blasting, ventilation, mucking and support. Time-allowed cycles = floor(24 ÷ cycle time); actual cycles = min(planned cycles, time-allowed cycles), so both planning and time constrain the result.
map.进尺与工期：日进尺=单循环进尺×实际循环数，月进尺=日进尺×30；工具另按 10: Advance and schedule: daily advance = advance per cycle × actual cycles, monthly advance = daily advance × 30. The tool also estimates schedule months for a 1,000 m single-heading drive as 1,000 ÷ daily advance ÷ 30, to compare the marginal benefit of different operation combinations (e.g., adding a drilling jumbo to shorten drilling time, or optimizing mucking to shorten the cycle).
map.算例：孔深 3 m、利用率 0.9 的全断面法日进尺: Example: daily advance for a full-face method with 3 m hole depth and 0.9 utilization
map.Input: 孔深 3 m、利用率 0.9、钻孔 3 h、爆破 1 h、通风 0: Input: hole depth 3 m, utilization 0.9, drilling 3 h, blasting 1 h, ventilation 0.5 h, mucking 3 h, support 2 h, planned cycles 3/day. Advance per cycle = 3 × 0.9 = 2.70 m; cycle time = 3 + 1 + 0.5 + 3 + 2 = 9.50 h; time-allowed cycles = floor(24 ÷ 9.5) = 2/day; actual cycles = min(3, 2) = 2/day (limited by time, not plan); daily advance = 2.70 × 2 = 5.40 m; monthly advance (full load) = 162 m; 1,000 m schedule ≈ 6.2 months. Comparison: hole depth 4 m and drilling 4 h (others unchanged) → advance 3.60 m, cycle 10.50 h, 2 cycles/day, daily advance 7.20 m, monthly 216 m, schedule 4.6 months; a short-advance fast-cycle option (hole depth 2 m, η=0.85, drilling 2 h, blasting 0.5 h, ventilation 0.5 h, mucking 2 h, support 1.5 h, planned 4 cycles/day) → advance 1.70 m, cycle 6.50 h, floor(24 ÷ 6.5) = 3 cycles/day, daily advance 5.10 m, monthly 153 m, schedule 6.5 months.
map.为什么实际循环数常常小于我填写的计划循环数？: Why is the actual cycle count often lower than my planned count?
map.因为工具取 min(计划循环数, floor(24÷单循环时间))。当五个工序耗: Because the tool takes min(planned cycles, floor(24 ÷ cycle time)). When the five operations add up to a long cycle, the planned count simply cannot fit into a day; the bottleneck is cycle time, not planning. To speed up, optimize the longest operation: if drilling dominates, add a drilling jumbo or multi-boom drill and use deeper-hole blasting; if mucking dominates, increase haulage capacity and shorten the haul; if support is slow, separate temporary shotcrete support from later permanent support.
map.炮孔利用率 η 一般取多少，加大孔深一定会更快吗？: What value should blast-hole utilization η take, and does a deeper hole always mean faster advance?
map.η 通常在 0.85~0.95：完整硬岩、钻孔精度高时取 0.90~0.95，破: η is usually 0.85–0.95: 0.90–0.95 for intact hard rock with accurate drilling, around 0.85 or lower for fractured zones and soft rock. A deeper hole raises advance per cycle, but deep-hole drilling takes longer, confinement is stronger, η often drops, and the longer cycle reduces daily cycles, so there is an optimal hole depth. Compare several 2–4 m depth and operation combinations with this tool and choose the one with the highest daily advance.
map.输入：孔深 3 m、利用率 0.9、钻孔 3 h、爆破 1 h、通风 0.5 h: Input: hole depth 3 m, utilization 0.9, drilling 3 h, blasting 1 h, ventilation 0.5 h, mucking 3 h, support 2 h, planned cycles 3/day. Advance per cycle = 3 × 0.9 = 2.70 m; cycle time = 3 + 1 + 0.5 + 3 + 2 = 9.50 h; time-allowed cycles = floor(24 ÷ 9.5) = 2/day; actual cycles = min(3, 2) = 2/day (limited by time, not plan); daily advance = 2.70 × 2 = 5.40 m; monthly advance (full load) = 162 m; 1,000 m schedule ≈ 6.2 months. Comparison: hole depth 4 m and drilling 4 h (others unchanged) → advance 3.60 m, cycle 10.50 h, 2 cycles/day, daily advance 7.20 m, monthly 216 m, schedule 4.6 months; a short-advance fast-cycle option (hole depth 2 m, η=0.85, drilling 2 h, blasting 0.5 h, ventilation 0.5 h, mucking 2 h, support 1.5 h, planned 4 cycles/day) → advance 1.70 m, cycle 6.50 h, floor(24 ÷ 6.5) = 3 cycles/day, daily advance 5.10 m, monthly 153 m, schedule 6.5 months.
map.输入孔深、利用率与各工序耗时，估算单循环进尺、循环数与日/月进尺；孔深、利用率、: Estimate cycle advance, cycles per day, daily and monthly advance from hole depth, utilization and process times. Invalid inputs clear old results, and zero daily advance produces no schedule estimate.
map.整循环模型：时间允许的完整循环=floor(有效日工时÷单循环时间)，实际完整循: Full-cycle model: complete cycles allowed = floor(effective daily hours ÷ cycle time); actual complete cycles = min(planned cycles, allowed). Daily advance = per-cycle advance × complete cycles. A cycle may not span days; if cycle time exceeds daily hours, daily advance is 0.
map.跨日平均模型：按连续施工折算每日循环=min(计划循环数, 有效日工时÷单循环时: Cross-day average model: cycles per day = min(planned cycles, effective daily hours ÷ cycle time), allowing a cycle to span days. Daily advance = per-cycle advance × equivalent cycles. Used for continuous excavation and duration estimates.
map.月进尺与工期：月进尺=跨日平均日进尺×30；工期=目标掘进长度÷跨日平均日进尺。: Monthly advance and duration: monthly = cross-day average daily advance × 30; duration = target length ÷ cross-day average daily advance. Advance over the planned construction days is also shown to compare process combinations.
map.为什么整循环日进尺和跨日平均日进尺会不同？: Why do full-cycle and cross-day average daily advance differ?
map.整循环模型要求每个循环都在当日工时内完成，余下不足一个循环的时间不计入进尺；跨日: The full-cycle model requires every cycle to finish within the day, so leftover time that is less than one cycle adds no advance. The cross-day model converts leftover time into a fractional cycle under continuous work, so the two differ whenever cycle time does not divide daily hours. The first suits shift scheduling without cross-day cycles; the second suits continuous excavation and duration estimates. Both are shown so neither is treated as the only truth.
map.单循环总耗时填 0 为什么不能估算？: Why can’t the tool estimate when total cycle time is 0?
map.单循环时间是计算每日循环数与工期的分母。总耗时为 0 不是“无限快”，而是缺少有: Cycle time is the denominator for cycles per day and duration. A total of 0 does not mean infinitely fast; it means the process data is missing. The page requires a total greater than 0 and clears old results to avoid meaningless days from a zero denominator.
map.进尺 = l × η ， 日进尺 = 进尺 × 每日循环数: Advance = l × η; daily advance = advance × cycles per day
map.整循环日进尺 = 进尺 × min(计划循环数, floor(有效日工时 ÷ 循: Full-cycle daily advance = advance × min(planned cycles, floor(effective hours ÷ cycle time))
map.跨日平均日进尺 = 进尺 × min(计划循环数, 有效日工时 ÷ 循环时间)，: Cross-day average daily advance = advance × min(planned cycles, effective hours ÷ cycle time), allowing cycles to span days
map.月进尺 = 跨日平均日进尺 × 30；工期 = 目标长度 ÷ 跨日平均日进尺（按: Monthly advance = cross-day average daily advance × 30; duration = target length ÷ cross-day average daily advance (continuous work)
map.算例：孔深 3 m、利用率 0.9、循环 9.5 h: Example: 3 m hole depth, 0.9 utilization, 9.5 h cycle
map.输入孔深 3 m、利用率 0.9、钻孔 3 h、爆破 1 h、通风 0.5 h、: Inputs: hole depth 3 m, utilization 0.9, drilling 3 h, blasting 1 h, ventilation 0.5 h, mucking 3 h, support 2 h, planned 3 cycles/day, 24 effective hours. Advance per cycle = 2.70 m; cycle time = 9.50 h. Full-cycle model floor(24÷9.5)=2 cycles/day, daily advance 5.40 m. Cross-day average 24÷9.5=2.526 cycles/day, daily advance 6.82 m; monthly about 204.6 m; 1000 m duration about 146.6 days (4.9 months). With 8 effective hours: full cycles 0/day; cross-day average 0.842 cycles/day, daily advance 2.27 m, monthly 68.2 m, 1000 m duration about 439.8 days. This shows why the average model matters when a cycle spans days.
